payload.abstract: A total of 120 participants with knee osteoarthritis were randomized in parallel groups to supervised exercise or education. The primary outcome, pain score at 8 weeks, improved more with exercise (p = 0.02).

In a 2x2 factorial trial, 400 smokers were randomized to varenicline or placebo and to counselling or none. The primary outcome, abstinence at 6 months, was higher with varenicline than placebo (p = 0.004).
We randomized 58 adults with insomnia to a crossover of melatonin and placebo, 4 weeks each. Total sleep time, the primary outcome, did not differ between treatments (p = 0.47).

A total of 86 patients after hip surgery were randomized in two parallel groups to early mobilization or standard care. The primary outcome, length of hospital stay, was shorter with early mobilization (p = 0.01).

In this parallel trial, 310 adults with type 2 diabetes were randomized to a low-carbohydrate diet or a standard diet. HbA1c at 6 months, the primary outcome, did not differ between groups (p = 0.29).
